Elective module courses, Master's Course: to be announced
All business language courses start on October 12, 2026, unless otherwise noted in the QIS/LSF.
Business language courses are primarily designed for students from the Faculty of Business Administration, but students from other departments can register for the 'courses for all students'.
For the courses for all students: no specific language requirement, but students may take courses in two to three languages.
For elective module courses: students may take 2 courses in English and one course in French and/or Spanish.
It does not matter whether B2.1 or B2.2 is achieved - what matters is that the B2 level is reached overall.
Our language certificates are generally unlimited in validity, meaning they do not have an expiration date and retain their legal validity.
In practice, many institutions or universities often require a certificate that is not older than two years to ensure that the proven language skills are still current.
This email address handles all inquiries regarding the business language courses. Please contact this address first and not the instructors.
For questions that can only be answered by instructors, your emails will be forwarded to the correct address.
